title: Stop and Debug Training
summary: Review validation stopping decisions and same-fixture training-failure diagnosis.

steps.title: Stop training using validation behavior without consulting the protected test

blocks.text: Early stopping follows predeclared improvement and patience rules. Preserve the accepted checkpoint, not automatically the last epoch.

Declare the validation quantity, direction, min_delta and patience. For minimization, reset the consecutive non-improvement count only if current < best − min_delta; otherwise increment and stop when patience is exhausted. best is the most recently accepted checkpoint’s value, not necessarily the lowest observation. Retain that checkpoint’s weights.

A state_dict references live values: deep-copy the accepted state or save it before further updates. Keep protected-test observations out of preprocessing fit, model selection and tuning to avoid leakage. Bound the controller’s while loop by maximum epochs and the non-improvement rule. Update best loss and checkpoint within the improvement branch; break when patience is exhausted.

steps.title: Validation patience: accepted checkpoint versus lowest loss

blocks.text: Trace the registered validation sequence using its strict min_delta comparison. A smaller observed loss can still be insufficient improvement, leaving the previously accepted checkpoint unchanged. Reset or increment the counter at every epoch, and honor both patience and the maximum-epoch bound. Deep-copy or save weights when improvement is accepted, then restore that snapshot instead of the last live weights. Protected-test observations do not choose patience or the checkpoint.
A live state_dict is not a frozen snapshot. A small loss decrease need not pass min_delta; preserve the accepted state before later updates.

Read the minimized-validation controller excerpts. Decide whether each respects strict minimum improvement, patience, bounded execution, independent checkpoint preservation and the protected-test boundary.

2 | 0.44 | 0.02 | 2 | 10 | True | 0.44 | 0 | 2 | False
3 | 0.43 | 0.02 | 2 | 10 | False | 0.44 | 1 | 2 | False
4 | 0.45 | 0.02 | 2 | 10 | False | 0.44 | 2 | 2 | True
``` Classify every supplied excerpt; judge the criterion named in that excerpt.

items.text:
```python
from copy import deepcopy
epoch, counter = 0, 0
best = float("inf")
while epoch < maximum_epochs:
    epoch += 1
    current = validation_losses[epoch - 1]
    if current < best - min_delta:
        best, best_epoch = current, epoch
        best_state = deepcopy(model.state_dict())
        counter = 0
    else:
        counter += 1
    if counter >= patience: break
model.load_state_dict(best_state)
return best_epoch, best
```
Only training/validation observations are available to this controller.
For the same trace, the controller resets the counter whenever current < best, ignoring min_delta.

```python

```
The same model continues updating and no deep copy or saved state file is used.
The controller chooses patience by comparing outcomes on protected test observations.

steps.title: Diagnose training failures from loss and gradient behavior

blocks.text: Reproduce the failure; inspect loss, representation and gradients before changing settings.

Inspect expected trainable parameters’ .grad after backward and before clearing. Compare losses, output/target compatibility and learning rate with the declared computation. Choose one evidence-supported correction and rerun the identical bounded fixture, comparing loss and gradient records with the failing reference.

Assert valid, boundary and failure predicates; false predicates raise AssertionError in ordinary non-optimized execution. Follow the derivative chain from loss through outputs to parameters, checking expected signs and measured magnitudes. Test one root-cause hypothesis on the reproduced failure.
